source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 9 summary (PDF 223).

blocks.text: Is chapter ne entrepreneurship batayi: jiddat, masail ka hal aur qadr paida karna; insan markooz tareeqe ke taur par design thinking; market analysis aur maali mansooba bandi ke saath business plan; market insights aur pitch; marketing aur sales ki hikmat-e-amli; maali intezam; baat cheet, storytelling aur tawun; aur jiddat aur takhleeqi salahiyat, jo students ko apne karobar shuru karne aur chalane ke auzaar deti hain.

items: Users samjhein, karobar ka mansooba, market jaanein, achhi pitch, paisa sambhalein, baat cheet, tawun, iteration aur jiddat.
